## How to check it

<!-- The steps to see the change in the editor, or why tests are enough. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes (it covers the whole repo, `site/` too)
- [ ] The code follows the style of the files around it, and comments that explain why are kept
- [ ] Engine changes have tests
- [ ] New visible strings are in every language of `src/i18n/`
- [ ] Interface changes: screenshots taken again (`npm run screenshots`) and the design system updated
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under _Unreleased_, if people will notice
